question: Should OpenClaw core expose a public `chat-background` CLI/RPC mutator before the macOS 26 private selector path is visually proven?
rationale: This adds new public feature surface around private Messages APIs, and source inspection cannot decide whether maintainers want a speculative mutator or only diagnostics until the selector contract is known.

options.title: Hold for working set/clear proof
options.body: Require the implementation to stop reporting success for non-effective calls and include redacted macOS 26 proof that set and clear visibly change a disposable chat before merge.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics
options.body: Keep selector/status probing but remove the mutating CLI/RPC methods until the required background details object is identified.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the draft if maintainers do not want speculative chat-background mutation in core.

recommendation.title: Hold for working set/clear proof
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to stop reporting success for non-effective calls and include redacted macOS 26 proof that set and clear visibly change a disposable chat before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-main routing candidate for adjacent bridge chat-management behavior and private-selector release risk.
